about.title: About
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Bilal, a full-stack software engineer motivated by technical challenges and passionate about innovation. My focus is on designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable web and mobile applications.

I graduated from ENSA Fès with a degree in Computer Engineering. Since then, I've had the chance to work across agritech, enterprise software, and national banking contexts. My main focus these days is building national TPE/PME scoring services and modernizing central platforms at Bank Al-Maghrib.
I continuously explore new tools and methods, particularly in microservices architectures and AI automation with tools like GitHub Copilot, RAG, and LLMs.

featured.title: National TPE/PME Scoring Services
featured.description: Designed and developed national scoring services for TPE/PME at Bank Al-Maghrib. Modeled business specifications and workflows via Vizor Builder.

featured.title: Customer Engagement Platform
featured.description: Integrated and optimized a Customer Engagement platform at Sopra Banking Software. Modernized architecture into microservices and integrated a Product Management module.

other.title: Agritech Platform
other.description: Developed a responsive agritech platform with a robust backend and modern frontend interface during my time at Twins Gestion du terroir.

other.title: Automated CMS Platform
other.description: Developed a CMS site with automated content workflows as a Web Developer Intern at DevBay.

other.title: Product Management System Redesign
other.description: Modernized the architecture into microservices and translated business needs into user stories for a banking software system.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.description: Whether you have a question about my experience across banking and enterprise systems, or just want to connect, my inbox is always open. I'll try my best to get back to you.
